newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysia Air, GE in engine venture.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia Air, GE in engine venture.

text.p: Malaysia Airline System Bhd (MAS) and the General Electric Company of the United States have signed a memorandum of understanding to jointly establish an engine-overhaul centre in Malaysia, MAS said in a statement on Friday.
The centre will specialise in the maintenance and overhaul of aircraft engines servicing GE's Asia Pacific customers, currently being services in the United States and Europe.
Negotiations on the venture are "expected to be finalised later this year, with joint venture operations to commence in January 1997," the statement said.
The joint venture will enhance the activities of an existing aero-service facility at the Subang international airport in Kuala Lumpur, MAS said.
The joint venture will be between MAS and GE's wholly owned subsidiary, GE Engine Services.
